contract_map.contract: Consistency and original identity, without origin authentication
contract_map.limit: Caller supplies digest/revision/format; independently obtaining them remains an operator obligation. provider_record.origin_authenticated_by_replay is false.

contract_map.contract: Execution revision differs from trusted reader identity
contract_map.limit: execution_revision names retained producer source; reader_sources hashes local inputs at import, entry and exit. Reader Git revision/working-tree state are separately captured by the handoff.

contract_map.contract: Per-format population and combined same-revision review
contract_map.limit: Derived fixed per-format counts are 16 framework calls, 36+36+36 launches, 180 framework event/profile pairs. The two-format 32/216 total is an operator aggregation rule requiring independent passes and equal execution revision; there is no combined CLI result.

contract_map.contract: Copied packets add zero launches; all retained member bytes checked
contract_map.limit: 663 is the documented observed data-member count of these selected originals. Byte equality and exact inventories, rather than packet copies, determine population.

contract_map.contract: Actual numerical, tensor, dispatch, lifecycle and raw-log consistency
contract_map.limit: Trusted local frozen fixtures and parsers validate retained observations; no current native execution or machine-code behavior is inferred.

contract_map.contract: Separate live and retained validation with inert producer paths
contract_map.limit: Live entry points retain directory/file/adapter-byte checks. Retained entry points use lexical paths and joined immutable facts. Chosen local reader code is trusted.

contract_map.contract: Retained first-party package joins versus absent external bytes
contract_map.limit: Missing third-party/interpreter/tool/seed/metadata bytes remain receipt consistency only. third_party_bytes_rehashed and interpreter_bytes_rehashed are false; reproducible compilation and third-party qualification are explicitly excluded.

Bounded envelopes, retained bytes and outcome labels only; host_fault_semantics_revalidated and host_test_results_revalidated remain false. Independent a33 review is additional evidence, not a public-reader guarantee.

contract_map.contract: No execution/acceptance flags and failure exits
contract_map.limit: Success is printed only after final archive and reader checks. Handled replay failures return exit 1 plus small failure JSON with all four negative flags. --help is text/0; argparse usage failures are stderr/2/no JSON. Initialization is outside the result handler.
